items.text: Parents are suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their 31-year-old daughter, who had epilepsy, to taper off her seizure drug and keep it from her doctors before she died in February. OpenAI calls it heartbreaking and says it involved an older version.

Trend Micro found a hacking kit that splits the work across 44 AI agents, from scouting to stealing data; at least 16 Japanese organizations were probed. None is named, and no break-in is reported for them.
The flaw under most websites, day 8: still no victim named. The US federal deadline to fix the two listed flaws is tomorrow, Oct 29.
